title: The Lesbian Code
overview: Real life stories of Seattle Lesbians, telling the truth of acceptance, professional backgrounds, coming out stories, bullying, crazy stories, laughter & love. Being real and letting others out there know what they are all about & what it's like to live in this community. The different types of lesbians out in the world showing that they may be exactly the opposite of what people may think about them. Stereotypes are all over, but times are changing.
